title: EFE structured-log common envelope (v1.0)
description: Sprint D13. Fields shared by every log stream emitted by efe-server. Pinned by scripts/tests/test_d13_log_schemas.py.

schema_version.description: MAJOR.MINOR. MAJOR change = surface-breaking. MINOR change = additive.

stream.description: Discriminator selecting which per-stream schema applies.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp ; nanosecond precision allowed (e.g. 2026-04-27T14:30:00.123456Z).

level.description: Log level. WARN/ERROR are alertable ; INFO is the bulk.

request_id.description: UUID v4 stamped at request entry. Survives across logs / traces / metrics for correlation.

tenant_id.description: Canonical tenant identifier ; matches the JWT tenant_id claim.

principal.description: JWT `sub` claim. Empty for pre-auth events (e.g. anonymous health checks).

service.description: Stable service identifier. Hardcoded — useful when multiple EFE instances ship to one Loki.

service_version.description: SemVer of the binary that emitted the log.
